notablePrerequisites: Joraga Treespeaker does not have summoning sickness, and has at least one level counter on it.
description:
Activate Joraga Treespeaker by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Joraga Treespeaker.
Repeat.
